fields.label: Method type
fields.value: Two online rating experiments (Amazon Mechanical Turk) with slider responses

fields.label: Summary
fields.value: Three experiments test whether listeners' prior beliefs about the probability of the content of a clause-embedding predicate's complement modulate how strongly the speaker is taken to be committed to it (projection).

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Whether subjective prior beliefs about the probability of utterance content modulate projection.

fields.label: Gap
fields.value: Previous research yielded conflicting results (Lorson, 2018; Mahler, 2020).

fields.label: Aim
fields.value: Test whether prior beliefs modulate projection at the categorical, group and individual level.

fields.label: Method
fields.value: Mixed-effects linear regression with random by-item and by-participant intercepts and slopes for fact type, fitted in R with lme4. Prior check: slider rating predicted from dummy-coded fact type (reference: lower probability). Projection: certainty rating predicted from fact type, from group-level by-item mean prior belief, or from the participant's individual prior rating.

fields.label: Model comparison
fields.value: Bayesian information criterion (BIC) comparison of the three models, with AIC as a robustness check.

fields.label: Method
fields.value: Mixed-effects linear regression with random by-item and by-participant intercepts and slopes for fact type, fitted in R with lme4. Slider rating predicted from dummy-coded fact type.

fields.label: Method
fields.value: Mixed-effects linear regression with random by-item and by-participant intercepts and slopes for fact type, fitted in R with lme4. Certainty rating predicted from categorical fact type or from continuous group-level prior means.

fields.label: Answer
fields.value: Content is more likely to project the more a priori likely it is.

fields.label: Support
fields.value: Experiment 1 supports group-level and participant-level associations; Experiment 2b replicates the group-level association using prior ratings from a separate group in Experiment 2a.

fields.label: Scope
fields.value: English clause-embedding predicates; 20 properties of individuals as prior manipulation; MTurk samples.
